ctx.x: Well, what about the English trad scene? I mean, as you say, you feel you're very much under the influence of George Lewis. What about the bands over there? Do you feel that they are too imitative? Or that they are going to derive something from this and build it into their own? Are they commercial? Or can you generalise? Or what?

Well, just generally speaking, they came under the George Lewis influence very much some years ago. And quite a few good bands were formed. Some of them were much too imitative. But there were some quite good jazz bands formed. Unfortunately, the jazz scene grew there. And it's become very much commercialised now. There's big money to be made by some bands. Chris Barber showed that first. Followed by Ackerbilk, Kenny Ball. Their jazz content has declined rapidly as they've become popular bands. And unfortunately,…
